items.title: CI4MS is a CodeIgniter 4-based content management system skeleton. Prior to version 0.31.9.0, the custom `html_purify` validation rule used to sanitize blog post bodies relies o...
items.summary: CI4MS is a CodeIgniter 4-based content management system skeleton. Prior to version 0.31.9.0, the custom `html_purify` validation rule used to sanitize blog post bodies relies on by-reference mutation (`?string &$str`), but CodeIgniter 4's validator passes a local copy of the value, so the sanitized text is silently discarded. The Blog controller writes `$lanData['content']` directly into `blog_langs.content`, and the public template echoes it without escaping — yielding stored XSS executable in any visitor's browser, including the superadmin when previewing or editing posts. Version 0.31.9.0 patches the issue.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-45138 是 CI4MS（基于 CodeIgniter 4 的内容管理系统骨架）中的一个存储型跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞。漏洞源于自定义的 `html_purify` 验证规则设计缺陷：该规则通过引用传参（`?string &$str`）对用户输入进行净化，但 CodeIgniter 4 的验证器在处理时传递的是参数的本地副本，导致净化后的文本未实际存储到原始变量中，被静默丢弃。因此，博客文章内容字段 `$lanData['content']` 直接存储了未经净化的原始输入。后续渲染时，公开模板直接输出该字段内容且未进行转义，攻击者可通过发表包含恶意 JavaScript 的博客文章实现存储型 XSS。任何访问该博客页面的用户（包括超级管理员在预览或编辑文章时）都会触发恶意脚本，可能导致会话劫持、敏感信息泄露等。该漏洞影响 0.31.9.0 之前的所有版本，CVSS 评分为 5.4（中等风险）。建议立即升级至 0.31.9.0 或更高版本，并在网络层面限制对管理员后台的访问。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 存储型 XSS 可直接在管理员浏览器中执行，威胁高；且修复前所有用户均受影响，补丁已发布，必须紧急升级。

items.title: Meshtastic is an open source mesh networking solution. Prior to version 2.7.21.1370b23, the Meshtastic GitHub repository's main_matrix.yml workflow is triggered by pull_request_...
items.summary: Meshtastic is an open source mesh networking solution. Prior to version 2.7.21.1370b23, the Meshtastic GitHub repository's main_matrix.yml workflow is triggered by pull_request_target  and multiple jobs check out the attacker's fork code and execute it with access to repository secrets and elevated GITHUB_TOKEN permissions. No approval gate exists. Pull requests from external users with author_association: "NONE" triggered the CI workflow automatically. The workflow directly executes attacker-controlled files from the fork checkout. This issue could have resulted in supply chain compromise, self-hosted runner compromise, and/or repository takeover for the repo. This issue is separate from GHSA-6mwm-v2vv-pp96, which addressed a command injection via github.head_ref in the setup job of the same workflow. That fix correctly moved to environment variables. However, the more critical fork checkout vulnerability across the check, build, and build-debian-src jobs was not addressed. Version 2.7.21.1370b23 contains a patch for thie issue.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Meshtastic 是一个开源网状网络解决方案。在版本 2.7.21.1370b23 之前，其 GitHub 仓库的 main_matrix.yml 工作流存在严重安全漏洞。该工作流由 pull_request_target 事件触发，多个作业（check、build、build-debian-src）会检出攻击者的分支代码并直接执行，同时工作流具有访问仓库机密和提升的 GITHUB_TOKEN 权限。触发时没有审批流程，外部用户（author_association: "NONE"）的拉取请求会自动触发 CI 工作流。攻击者可通过提交恶意拉取请求，在自托管运行器或 GitHub 托管的运行器上执行任意代码，从而窃取机密、篡改构建产物，甚至完全接管仓库。此漏洞独立于之前修复的 GHSA-6mwm-v2vv-pp96（该修复仅解决了 setup 作业中通过 github.head_ref 进行的命令注入，但未解决其他作业中直接从分支检出执行代码的根因）。版本 2.7.21.1370b23 已修复此漏洞，修复方式包括限制拉取触发器或移除不必要的权限。建议所有用户立即升级到修复版本。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: CVSS 10.0 临界漏洞，攻击者可远程、无需认证、无需用户交互即可利用，导致供应链攻击或仓库接管，影响整个 Meshtastic 生态安全。

items.title: Meshtastic is an open source mesh networking solution. Prior to version 2.7.23.b246bcd, a single node advertising a User.long_name that contains a malformed character encoding c...
items.summary: Meshtastic is an open source mesh networking solution. Prior to version 2.7.23.b246bcd, a single node advertising a User.long_name that contains a malformed character encoding can render other radios unusable over BLE when managed through the iOS app. The malformed name does not need to be maliciously crafted — it can arise from ordinary buffer truncation and has been observed occurring naturally in the wild. At least one code path could place a null terminator in the middle of a multibyte sequence, leaving a malformed User.long_name in the node database. The problem surfaced downstream: the iOS app enforced encoding validation and therefore cannot parse a node database once it contains a poisoned entry. This caused BLE sync to enter a fail/retry loop, resulting in loss of control over the affected device. For a typical user managing their radio with the iOS app, the device becomes effectively unusable until the poisoned node ages out of the on-device database, or unless they have an alternate management path (e.g., the Python CLI, which can be used to identify and remove the offending entries manually). Because the malformed name propagates through the mesh, the temporary presence of a single affected node can degrade BLE management for iOS users across a wide geographical area for an extended period. Less technical users have no straightforward recovery path. Starting in version 2.7.23.b246bcd, the firmware has added input sanitization and regression tests demonstrating recovery for already-poisoned devices. The apps have also taken steps to ensure more graceful handling of malformed encoding sequences as well.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-42566 是开源 mesh 网络解决方案 Meshtastic 的一个高危漏洞（CVSS 7.5）。该漏洞存在于 2.7.23.b246bcd 之前的固件版本中，由于对用户长名称（User.long_name）的编码验证不足，一个节点广播包含畸形字符编码的名称即可导致其他 iOS 设备通过 BLE 管理时无法正常使用。问题根源在于固件在处理长名称时可能将空终止符插入多字节序列中间，导致节点数据库中存储了畸形的 UTF-8 字符串。iOS 应用执行严格的编码验证，因此无法解析包含该病态条目的数据库，从而触发 BLE 同步进入失败-重试循环，用户丧失对设备的控制能力。畸形名称并非必须恶意构造，实际中因普通缓冲区截断即可自然产生，且已在野外观察到。该名称会通过 mesh 网络传播，导致受影响 iOS 用户的地理范围扩大，且非技术用户难以恢复，除非病态条目自动老化或通过 Python CLI 手动清除。在 2.7.23.b246bcd 版本中，固件增加了输入净化并提供了恢复已中毒设备的回归测试，同时应用端也加强了对畸形编码序列的优雅处理。建议用户立即升级固件至 2.7.23.b246bcd 或更高版本，并限制未授权节点接入 mesh 网络。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Meshtastic 的 BLE 管理路径存在致命缺陷，iOS 用户可能因单个受感染节点完全失去设备控制权，且非技术用户难以恢复。漏洞可自然触发，影响范围广，需尽快打补丁。

items.title: A vulnerability in keras-team/keras version 3.15.0 allows unsafe deserialization of attacker-controlled PyTorch pickle data through the public `keras.layers.TorchModuleWrapper.f...
items.summary: A vulnerability in keras-team/keras version 3.15.0 allows unsafe deserialization of attacker-controlled PyTorch pickle data through the public `keras.layers.TorchModuleWrapper.from_config` method. This method invokes `torch.load(..., weights_only=False)` without requiring an explicit unsafe opt-in, such as a `safe_mode=False` parameter. When called outside a `SafeModeScope(True)` context, the absence of an ambient safe mode state permits unsafe deserialization by default. This issue can lead to arbitrary code execution if untrusted Keras layer configurations are processed using this method. The vulnerability arises because the method does not enforce safe deserialization practices unless explicitly guarded by Keras safe mode.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-12484 是 keras-team/keras 版本 3.15.0 中的一个安全漏洞。该漏洞源于 `keras.layers.TorchModuleWrapper.from_config` 方法在反序列化 PyTorch pickle 数据时，默认调用了 `torch.load(..., weights_only=False)`，而未强制要求显式的安全模式选择（例如通过 `safe_mode=False` 参数）。当调用该方法的代码不在 `SafeModeScope(True)` 上下文环境中时，由于缺乏环境安全模式的默认保护，攻击者可以提供特制的 Keras 层配置（包含恶意的 PyTorch pickle 数据），从而触发不安全的反序列化。此漏洞可导致任意代码执行，攻击者可能完全控制受影响系统。CVSS 评分为 7.8（高），攻击向量为本地，但无需特权，仅需用户交互（如加载恶意配置）。该漏洞影响使用 `from_config` 方法处理不可信 Keras 层配置的场景，例如通过模型配置文件或用户输入加载自定义层。虽然该漏洞需要攻击者能够提供恶意配置，但若应用程序允许用户上传或加载任意 Keras 模型配置，则风险显著。目前尚无已知的在野利用或官方补丁，建议用户在官方发布修复前，避免处理不可信的 Keras 配置，或确保在调用 `from_config` 时主动启用 `SafeModeScope(True)` 上下文。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许攻击者在无需显式关闭安全模式的情况下，通过构造的 PyTorch pickle 数据实现远程代码执行，利用了 Keras 中默认不安全的反序列化行为，威胁严重。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可导致任意代码执行，攻击者能完全控制受影响系统，可能窃取数据、安装后门或横向移动。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 建议用户在官方发布补丁前，避免处理不可信的 Keras 配置；若必须使用，确保在调用 `from_config` 时启用 `SafeModeScope(True)` 上下文。同时关注 keras-team 的更新，及时升级到修复版本。

items.title:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

iommu/amd: Remove latent out-of-bounds access in IOMMU debugfs

In iommu_mmio_write() and iommu_capability_w...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

iommu/amd: Remove latent out-of-bounds access in IOMMU debugfs

In iommu_mmio_write() and iommu_capability_write(), the variables
dbg_mmio_offset and dbg_cap_offset are declared as int. However, they
are populated using kstrtou32_from_user(). If a user provides a
sufficiently large value, it can become a negative integer.

Prior to this patch, the AMD IOMMU debugfs implementation was already
protected by different mechanisms.

1. #define OFS_IN_SZ 8 ensures the user string <= 8 bytes, so
   e.g. 0xffffffff isn't a valid input.

  if (cnt > OFS_IN_SZ)
     return -EINVAL;

2. Implicit type promotion in iommu_mmio_write(), dbg_mmio_offset is int
   and iommu->mmio_phys_end is u64

  if (dbg_mmio_offset > iommu->mmio_phys_end - sizeof(u64))
      return -EINVAL;

3. The show handlers would currently catch the negative number and
   refuse to perform the read.

Replace kstrtou32_from_user() with kstrtos32_from_user() to parse the
input, and check for negative values to explicitly prevent out-of-bounds
memory accesses directly in iommu_mmio_write() and
iommu_capability_write().

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞存在于 Linux 内核 AMD IOMMU 驱动程序的 debugfs 接口中。在函数 iommu_mmio_write() 和 iommu_capability_write() 中，变量 dbg_mmio_offset 和 dbg_cap_offset 被声明为 int 类型，但通过 kstrtou32_from_user() 从用户空间解析输入，该函数将字符串转换为无符号 32 位整数。如果用户提供足够大的数值（如 0xffffffff），转换后的值可能超出 int 范围，导致符号扩展为负数。尽管原有实现包含多重防护机制（如 OFS_IN_SZ 限制输入长度、隐式类型提升比较、show 处理程序会捕获负数并拒绝读取），但理论上仍存在绕过风险。补丁将 kstrtou32_from_user() 替换为 kstrtos32_from_user()，并在赋值后直接检查负值，从而明确阻止越界内存访问。此漏洞的利用需要本地访问权限，且需具备 debugfs 文件系统挂载条件。影响范围包括受影响的 Linux 内核版本（具体版本未公布，通常涉及 AMD IOMMU 调试功能的内核）。建议用户及时更新到包含此修复的内核版本（主线或发行版补丁），同时限制 debugfs 的访问权限，避免非授权用户操作。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞修复了 AMD IOMMU debugfs 中潜在的整数符号问题，可能被本地攻击者利用导致越界读写，造成系统崩溃或信息泄露。虽需本地访问，但内核稳定性受影响，建议尽快打补丁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 本地攻击者可能通过特制输入触发越界内存访问，导致内核崩溃（拒绝服务）或泄露敏感内核内存信息。

items.title:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

sysfs: don't remove existing directory on update failure

When sysfs_update_group() is called for a named gr...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

sysfs: don't remove existing directory on update failure

When sysfs_update_group() is called for a named group and create_files()
fails (e.g. -ENOMEM), internal_create_group() calls kernfs_remove(kn) on
the group directory.  In the update path, kn was obtained via
kernfs_find_and_get() and refers to a directory that already existed
before this call.  Removing it silently destroys a sysfs group that the
caller did not create.

Only remove the directory if we created it ourselves.  On update failure
the directory remains as it is left empty by remove_files() inside
create_files(), but can be repopulated by a retry.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Linux 内核的 sysfs 子系统存在一个缺陷，当调用 sysfs_update_group() 更新一个已存在的命名 sysfs 组时，如果 create_files() 函数因内存不足（-ENOMEM）等错误而失败，内部函数 internal_create_group() 会错误地调用 kernfs_remove(kn) 移除该组目录。由于在更新路径中，kn 是通过 kernfs_find_and_get() 获取的，指向调用前已经存在的目录，因此删除操作会静默地销毁一个并非由当前调用者创建的 sysfs 组。这可能导致系统组件依赖的 sysfs 接口突然消失，引发意外行为或功能异常。修复方案是仅在组目录由当前调用创建时才执行删除操作；若更新失败，目录保留但不含任何属性文件（已由 remove_files() 清理），后续可通过重试重新填充。该漏洞影响 Linux 内核，建议及时升级至包含补丁的版本。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可导致意外的 sysfs 组被删除，破坏系统接口的稳定性，可能影响依赖 sysfs 的驱动或用户态程序，属于内核功能正确性问题，无已知在野利用但建议修复。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞可导致意外的 sysfs 组被删除，破坏系统接口的稳定性，可能影响依赖 sysfs 的驱动或用户态程序，属于内核功能正确性问题，无已知在野利用但建议修复。

mm/damon/sysfs-schemes: call missing mem_cgroup_iter_break()

damon_sysfs_memcg_path_to_id() breaks mem_cgro...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

mm/damon/sysfs-schemes: call missing mem_cgroup_iter_break()

damon_sysfs_memcg_path_to_id() breaks mem_cgroup_iter() loop without
calling mem_cgroup_iter_break().  This leaks the cgroup reference.  Fix
the issue by calling mem_cgroup_iter_break() before the break.

The issue was discovered [1] by Sashiko.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 在Linux内核的mm/damon/sysfs-schemes组件中，发现一个内存管理漏洞（CVE-2026-64184）。函数damon_sysfs_memcg_path_to_id()在使用mem_cgroup_iter()遍历cgroup时，如果找到匹配路径，会提前跳出循环，但未调用mem_cgroup_iter_break()来释放循环中持有的cgroup引用，导致cgroup引用泄漏。此缺陷由Sashiko发现。虽然该漏洞本身不直接导致代码执行，但长期累积的引用泄漏可能消耗系统内存，影响稳定性，并可能在特定场景下被利用造成拒绝服务。受影响版本包括Linux内核所有使用该函数的版本。建议用户及时更新内核至包含补丁的版本，目前补丁已合入主线。对于无法立即更新的系统，可考虑限制对sysfs接口的访问以降低风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞导致cgroup引用泄漏，长期运行可能耗尽内存，影响系统稳定性。虽无CVSS评分，但属于内核内存管理缺陷，有必要及时修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可通过特定操作触发该路径，导致cgroup引用计数泄漏，长期积累可能造成系统内存耗尽，引发拒绝服务（DoS）。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞导致cgroup引用泄漏，长期运行可能耗尽内存，影响系统稳定性。虽无CVSS评分，但属于内核内存管理缺陷，有必要及时修复。

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

efi: Allocate runtime workqueue before ACPI init

Since commit

  5894cf571e14 ("acpi/prmt: Use EFI runtime ...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

efi: Allocate runtime workqueue before ACPI init

Since commit

  5894cf571e14 ("acpi/prmt: Use EFI runtime sandbox to invoke PRM handlers")

ACPI PRM calls are delegated to a workqueue which runs in a kernel
thread, making it easier to detect and mitigate faulting memory accesses
performed by the firmware.

Rafael reports that such PRM accesses may occur before efisubsys_init()
executes, which is where the workqueue is allocated, leading to NULL
pointer dereferences. Since acpi_init() [which triggers the early PRM
accesses] executes as a subsys_initcall() as well, and has its own
dependencies that may be sensitive to initcall ordering, deferring
acpi_init() is not an option.

So instead, split off the workqueue allocation into its own postcore
initcall, as this is the only missing piece to allow EFI runtime calls
to be made. This ensures that EFI runtime call (including PRM calls) are
accessible to all code running at subsys_initcall() level.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本漏洞影响 Linux 内核的 EFI 子系统和 ACPI PRM（平台运行时机制）交互。由于 commit 5894cf571e14（"acpi/prmt: Use EFI runtime sandbox to invoke PRM handlers"）将 ACPI PRM 处理委托给工作队列，而该工作队列在 efisubsys_init() 中分配，但某些 PRM 访问发生在 efisubsys_init() 之前（由 acpi_init() 触发，两者同为 subsys_initcall 级别）。initcall 顺序未保证，导致工作队列未分配时进行 PRM 调用，产生空指针解引用（NULL pointer dereference），系统崩溃。开发者选择将工作队列分配提前到 postcore initcall 阶段，确保所有 subsys_initcall 级别的代码都能安全使用 EFI 运行时调用，包括 PRM。此漏洞影响使用 ACPI PRM 的硬件平台（如某些服务器），攻击者可能通过本地触发特定 PRM 调用来导致拒绝服务（内核崩溃）。目前无证据表明已被在野利用，但建议尽快更新内核以修复该问题。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可导致系统崩溃（拒绝服务），影响使用 ACPI PRM 的 Linux 内核系统，且修复需更改 initcall 顺序，属于内核基础设施逻辑缺陷。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者通过触发特定 ACPI PRM 调用可能导致内核空指针解引用，系统崩溃，造成拒绝服务。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 更新 Linux 内核至包含以下补丁的版本（如 6.x 系列对应修复提交），并重启系统。临时缓解措施：限制本地用户权限，减少触发 PRM 调用的机会。

drivers/base/memory: fix memory block reference leak in poison accounting

memblk_nr_poison_inc() and memblk...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drivers/base/memory: fix memory block reference leak in poison accounting

memblk_nr_poison_inc() and memblk_nr_poison_sub() look up a memory block
via find_memory_block_by_id(), which acquires a reference to the memory
block device.

Both helpers use the returned memory block without dropping that
reference, leaking the device reference on each successful lookup.  Drop
the reference after updating nr_hwpoison.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 在Linux内核的drivers/base/memory子系统中，存在一个内存块设备引用泄漏漏洞。函数memblk_nr_poison_inc()和memblk_nr_poison_sub()用于增加或减少内存块的poison计数。它们通过调用find_memory_block_by_id()来查找对应的内存块，该函数会返回一个已增加引用计数的内存块指针。然而，这两个函数在更新nr_hwpoison计数后，并未释放该引用，导致每次成功查找都会泄漏一个设备引用。此漏洞会逐渐耗尽内核的内存资源，可能影响系统稳定性，甚至导致拒绝服务。受影响的内核版本需要应用补丁，补丁已在Linux内核代码仓库中提交，通过添加put_device()调用来释放引用。建议用户更新到包含此修复的内核版本。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可导致内核引用泄漏，长期运行下消耗系统资源，影响稳定性。无需用户交互即可触发，但利用门槛较高，建议及时打补丁。

items.title:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

mm: fix __vm_normal_page() to handle missing support for pmd_special()/pud_special()

On x86 32-bit with THP...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

mm: fix __vm_normal_page() to handle missing support for pmd_special()/pud_special()

On x86 32-bit with THP enabled, zap_huge_pmd() is seen to generate a
"WARNING: mm/memory.c:735 at __vm_normal_page+0x6a/0x7d", from the
VM_WARN_ON_ONCE(is_zero_pfn(pfn) || is_huge_zero_pfn(pfn)); followed by
"BUG: Bad rss-counter state"s, then later "BUG: Bad page state"s when
reclaim gets to call shrink_huge_zero_folio_scan().

It's as if the _PAGE_SPECIAL bit never got set in the huge_zero pmd: and
indeed, whereas pte_special() and pte_mkspecial() are subject to a
dedicated CONFIG_ARCH_HAS_PTE_SPECIAL, pmd_special() and pmd_mkspecial()
are subject to CONFIG_ARCH_SUPPORTS_PMD_PFNMAP, which is never enabled on
any 32-bit architecture.

While the problem was exposed through commit d80a9cb1a64a
("mm/huge_memory: add and use normal_or_softleaf_folio_pmd()"), it was an
oversight in commit af38538801c6 ("mm/memory: factor out common code from
vm_normal_page_*()") and would result in other problems:
* huge zero folio accounted in smaps, pagemap (PAGE_IS_FILE) and
  numamaps as file-backed THP
* folio_walk_start() returning the folio even without FW_ZEROPAGE set.
  Callers seem to tolerate that, though.

... and triggering the VM_WARN_ON_ONE(), although never reported so far.

To fix it, teach vm_normal_page_pmd()/vm_normal_page_pud() to consider
whether pmd_special/pud_special is actually implemented.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞存在于Linux内核的内存管理子系统中，具体位于__vm_normal_page()函数。在x86 32位系统上启用透明大页（THP）时，zap_huge_pmd()会触发一个内核警告：“WARNING: mm/memory.c:735 at __vm_normal_page+0x6a/0x7d”，随后出现“BUG: Bad rss-counter state”和“BUG: Bad page state”等错误。根本原因是pmd_special()和pud_special()的实现在32位架构上缺失：pte_special()受CONFIG_ARCH_HAS_PTE_SPECIAL控制，而pmd_special()受CONFIG_ARCH_SUPPORTS_PMD_PFNMAP控制，但该配置在32位系统上从不启用。因此， _PAGE_SPECIAL位在巨大零页的pmd条目中未被正确设置。该问题由commit d80a9cb1a64a（“mm/huge_memory: add and use normal_or_softleaf_folio_pmd()”）暴露，但根本缺陷在commit af38538801c6（“mm/memory: factor out common code from vm_normal_page_*()”）中被引入。该漏洞会导致巨大零页被错误统计为文件-backed THP，影响smaps、pagemap (PAGE_IS_FILE)和numamaps等统计数据；同时，folio_walk_start()在没有设置FW_ZEROPAGE的情况下返回folio，尽管调用者似乎容忍此行为。修复方案是修改vm_normal_page_pmd()和vm_normal_page_pud()，检查pmd_special/pud_special是否真正实现，从而避免错误处理。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞影响Linux内核的内存管理稳定性，在x86 32位系统上使用透明大页时可能触发内核警告和BUG，导致系统不稳定甚至崩溃，属于影响内核可靠性的重要缺陷。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 漏洞可导致内核警告输出、rss-counter状态损坏和页面状态异常，进而引发系统不稳定、内存管理错误，严重时可能造成系统崩溃或拒绝服务。

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

mm/memory_hotplug: fix memory block reference leak on remove

Patch series "mm: Fix memory block leaks and l...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

mm/memory_hotplug: fix memory block reference leak on remove

Patch series "mm: Fix memory block leaks and locking", v2.

This series fixes two memory block device reference leaks and one locking
issue around the per-memory_block hwpoison counter.


This patch (of 2):

remove_memory_blocks_and_altmaps() looks up each memory block with
find_memory_block(), which acquires a reference to the memory block
device.

That reference is never dropped on this path, resulting in a leaked device
reference when removing memory blocks and their altmaps.  Drop the
reference after retrieving mem->altmap and clearing mem->altmap, before
removing the memory block device.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-64180 是 Linux 内核内存热插拔子系统中的一个引用泄漏漏洞。当通过 remove_memory_blocks_and_altmaps() 函数移除内存块及其备用映射（altmap）时，函数调用 find_memory_block() 查找每个内存块，该操作会获取一个 device 引用。然而，在获取 mem->altmap 并清除该指针后，函数未释放该引用，导致设备引用泄漏。这会导致内存块设备无法被正确释放，进而造成内存泄漏和资源耗尽。该漏洞影响 Linux 内核的内存热插拔功能，在频繁进行内存热插拔操作的系统中可能导致系统不稳定或内存耗尽。补丁通过在被移除的内存块设备被删除前正确释放引用修复了该问题。目前暂无在野利用报告，CVSS 评分未分配，但鉴于其可能导致系统可用性受影响，建议用户及时更新内核至包含修复的版本。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞导致内存块设备引用泄漏，在内存热插拔操作中积累泄漏可能耗尽系统资源，影响系统稳定性和可用性，需优先修复。

The memory allocated in ipc_protocol_init() ...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

net: wwan: iosm: fix potential memory leaks in ipc_imem_init()

The memory allocated in ipc_protocol_init() is not freed on the error
paths that follow in ipc_imem_init(). Fix that by calling the
corresponding release function ipc_protocol_deinit() in the error path.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 在Linux内核的IOSM（Intel Onboard System Management）无线广域网（WWAN）子系统中，存在一个潜在的内存泄漏漏洞。具体问题出现在`ipc_imem_init()`函数中：函数通过`ipc_protocol_init()`分配的内存，在后续的错误路径上未被正确释放。这可能导致在错误处理时内存泄漏，长期运行可能耗尽系统内存，导致拒绝服务。补丁通过在错误路径中调用`ipc_protocol_deinit()`来释放已分配的内存，从而修复该问题。该漏洞影响使用IOSM驱动的Linux内核版本，主要针对支持WWAN的设备。由于该漏洞仅当初始化过程中发生错误时才被触发，且需要本地访问或特定条件，实际利用难度较高，但仍建议及时更新内核以消除隐患。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可能导致系统内存泄漏，在长时间运行或反复触发错误路径时耗尽内存，造成拒绝服务。虽然利用条件受限，但应及时修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可能通过触发错误路径导致内存泄漏，最终耗尽系统内存，影响系统可用性。

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

Bluetooth: bnep: Fix UAF read of dev->name

bnep_add_connection() needs to keep holding the bnep_session_sem...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

Bluetooth: bnep: Fix UAF read of dev->name

bnep_add_connection() needs to keep holding the bnep_session_sem while
reading dev->name (just like bnep_get_connlist() does); otherwise the
bnep_session() thread can concurrently free the net_device, which can for
example be triggered by a concurrent bnep_del_connection().

(This UAF is fairly uninteresting from a security perspective;
calling bnep_add_connection() requires passing a capable(CAP_NET_ADMIN)
check. It also requires completely tearing down a netdev during a fairly
tight race window.)

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞存在于 Linux 内核的蓝牙 bnep 子系统中。bnep_add_connection() 函数在读取 net_device 的 name 字段时未正确持有 bnep_session_sem 信号量，导致与 bnep_del_connection() 函数存在竞态条件。当 bnep_session() 线程并发执行时，可能释放 net_device，从而造成释放后读取（UAF）问题。攻击者需要具备 CAP_NET_ADMIN 权限才能调用 bnep_add_connection()，且需要完全拆除网络设备并在极窄的竞争窗口内触发，因此实际利用难度较高，安全影响有限。该漏洞可能导致内核信息泄露或系统崩溃。受影响的内核版本需要及时升级以修复此问题。建议运维人员关注官方内核更新公告，及时应用补丁。由于漏洞利用条件苛刻，一般情况下紧急程度较低，但仍建议在维护窗口内完成升级。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 虽然需要 CAP_NET_ADMIN 权限且竞争窗口狭窄，但一旦成功利用可导致内核信息泄露或系统崩溃，影响运行稳定性。

items.why_it_matters: 虽然需要 CAP_NET_ADMIN 权限且竞争窗口狭窄，但一旦成功利用可导致内核信息泄露或系统崩溃，影响运行稳定性。

items.title:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

phonet/pep: disable BH around forwarded sk_receive_skb()

The networking receive path is usually run from so...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

phonet/pep: disable BH around forwarded sk_receive_skb()

The networking receive path is usually run from softirq context, but
protocols that take the socket lock may have packets stored in the
backlog and processed later from process context. In that case
release_sock() -> __release_sock() drops the slock with spin_unlock_bh()
and then calls sk->sk_backlog_rcv() with bottom halves enabled.

Typical sk_backlog_rcv handlers process the socket whose backlog is
being drained, so the BH state at entry is irrelevant for the slocks
they touch. pep_do_rcv() is different: when the inbound skb targets an
existing PEP pipe, it forwards the skb to a different *child* socket
via sk_receive_skb(). That helper takes the child slock with
bh_lock_sock_nested(), which is just spin_lock_nested() and assumes BH
is already off. The same child slock therefore ends up acquired with
BH on (process path) and with BH off (softirq path):

  process context                   softirq context
  ---------------                   ---------------
  release_sock(listener)            __netif_receive_skb()
   __release_sock()                  phonet_rcv()
    spin_unlock_bh()                  __sk_receive_skb(listener)
    [BH now ENABLED]                  [BH already disabled]
    sk_backlog_rcv:                   sk_backlog_rcv:
     pep_do_rcv()                      pep_do_rcv()
      sk_receive_skb(child)             sk_receive_skb(child)
       bh_lock_sock_nested(child)        bh_lock_sock_nested(child)
       => SOFTIRQ-ON-W                   => IN-SOFTIRQ-W

Lockdep flags this as inconsistent lock state, and it can become a real
self-deadlock if a softirq on the same CPU tries to receive to the same
child socket while its slock is held in the BH-enabled path:

  WARNING: inconsistent lock state
  inconsistent {SOFTIRQ-ON-W} -> {IN-SOFTIRQ-W} usage.
   (slock-AF_PHONET/1){+.?.}-{3:3}, at: __sk_receive_skb+0x1cf/0x900
    __sk_receive_skb              net/core/sock.c:563
    sk_receive_skb                include/net/sock.h:2022 [inline]
    pep_do_rcv                    net/phonet/pep.c:675
    sk_backlog_rcv                include/net/sock.h:1190
    __release_sock                net/core/sock.c:3216
    release_sock                  net/core/sock.c:3815
    pep_sock_accept               net/phonet/pep.c:879

Wrap the forwarded sk_receive_skb() in local_bh_disable() /
local_bh_enable() so the child slock is always acquired with BH off.
local_bh_disable() nests safely on the softirq path.

Discovered via in-house syzkaller fuzzing; the same root cause also
on the linux-6.1.y syzbot dashboard as extid 44f0626dd6284f02663c.
Reproduced under KASAN + LOCKDEP + PROVE_LOCKING, reproducer:
https://pastebin.com/A3t8xzCR

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞存在于Linux内核的phonet/pep（Phonet协议）子系统中。在网络接收路径中，通常从软中断上下文运行，但某些协议（如Phonet）可能会将数据包存储在套接字的backlog中，并在进程上下文中延迟处理。当release_sock()调用__release_sock()时，会先通过spin_unlock_bh()释放slock并启用底部半部（BH），然后调用sk_backlog_rcv()处理backlog。一般处理函数只操作当前套接字的锁，不受BH状态影响。但pep_do_rcv()函数在处理针对现有PEP管道的入站skb时，会通过sk_receive_skb()将其转发给另一个子套接字。该辅助函数使用bh_lock_sock_nested()获取子套接字的slock，该函数仅调用spin_lock_nested()并假设BH已禁用。因此，当进程上下文（BH启用）和软中断上下文（BH禁用）同时访问同一个子套接字时，锁状态不一致（SOFTIRQ-ON-W vs IN-SOFTIRQ-W），Lockdep会报告错误，且可能导致真实的自死锁：如果同一CPU上的软中断尝试向已被BH启用路径持有slock的子套接字发送数据，则会发生死锁。该漏洞通过内部syzkaller fuzzing发现，同样出现在linux-6.1.y内核上，并附有reproducer。修复方法是在转发sk_receive_skb()前后调用local_bh_disable()/local_bh_enable()，确保子套接字的slock始终在BH禁用状态下获取，且local_bh_disable()在软中断路径中可以安全嵌套。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可能导致Linux系统内核死锁，影响系统稳定性和可用性。由于Phonet协议通常用于电信设备，关键基础设施可能受到影响。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可能通过精心构造的网络数据包触发死锁，导致系统崩溃或拒绝服务。虽然需要本地访问或特定网络条件，但后果严重。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞可能导致Linux系统内核死锁，影响系统稳定性和可用性。由于Phonet协议通常用于电信设备，关键基础设施可能受到影响。

items.title:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

wifi: iwlwifi: mvm: fix driver-set TX rates on old devices

On old devices such as 7265D, rates are still en...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

wifi: iwlwifi: mvm: fix driver-set TX rates on old devices

On old devices such as 7265D, rates are still encoded in version 1
format, which doesn't use the CCK/OFDM rate index (0-3/0-7) but
rather their PLCP value (e.g. 10 for 1 Mbps CCK rate.)

While introducing v3 rates, I changed the driver from internally
handling v1 rates and converting to v2, to internally handling v3
and converting to v1 or v2 according to the firmware. I accordingly
changed the code in iwl_mvm_mac80211_idx_to_hwrate() to no longer
have different values for different APIs. This was correct.

However, I later reverted this part of the change, because it was
reported that I had broken beacon rates, causing a FW assert/crash.
This caused TX_CMD rates to be set incorrectly, potentially causing
a warning when reported back from the device as having been used.

Fix this (hopefully correctly now) by handling beacon rates in the
TX_CMD that's embedded in the beacon template command separately.
Restore iwl_mvm_mac80211_idx_to_hwrate() to return only the rate
index, not PLCP value, fixing the real TX_CMD.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Linux 内核的 iwlwifi 驱动中，针对旧款无线设备（如 7265D）存在一个无线传输速率设置错误漏洞。该漏洞源于在引入 v3 速率格式时，驱动内部处理逻辑变更导致的回归。旧设备使用 v1 格式编码速率（采用 PLCP 值，例如 1Mbps CCK 速率为 10），而新驱动内部统一使用 v3 格式，并在发送命令时转换为 v1 或 v2 格式。此前，作者修改了 iwl_mvm_mac80211_idx_to_hwrate() 函数，使其不再根据不同 API 返回不同值，这本身是正确的。然而，由于该修改导致信标（beacon）速率错误，引发固件断言或崩溃，因此该部分改动被回退。回退后，正常的 TX_CMD 速率设置变成了错误格式（返回 PLCP 值而非速率索引），当设备上报使用过的速率时可能触发警告。本次修复将信标速率处理独立到信标模板命令中的 TX_CMD，同时恢复 iwl_mvm_mac80211_idx_to_hwrate() 仅返回速率索引（不返回 PLCP 值），从而正确设置实际 TX_CMD 的速率。该漏洞影响使用旧版固件 API 的旧款 iwlwifi 无线设备，可能导致无线通信异常、固件警告甚至系统不稳定。建议受影响用户及时更新包含此补丁的 Linux 内核版本。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 影响使用旧款 iwlwifi 无线网卡（如 7265D）的 Linux 系统，可能导致无线网络连接不稳定、速率异常或固件崩溃，进而影响通信可靠性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可利用该漏洞造成拒绝服务（设备崩溃）或无线通信异常，但无证据表明可在野外被武器化利用。

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

wifi: iwlwifi: mld: stop TX during firmware restart

When iwlwifi firmware crashes (e.g., NMI_INTERRUPT_UNKN...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

wifi: iwlwifi: mld: stop TX during firmware restart

When iwlwifi firmware crashes (e.g., NMI_INTERRUPT_UNKNOWN on Intel
BE201/Wi-Fi 7), iwl_mld_nic_error() sets mld->fw_status.in_hw_restart
to true. However, iwl_mld_tx_from_txq() does not check this flag before
dequeuing frames from mac80211 and pushing them to the transport layer.

Since the firmware is dead, iwl_trans_tx() returns -EIO for each frame,
which then gets freed immediately. Under high-throughput conditions
(e.g., Tailscale UDP traffic or active SSH sessions), this creates a
tight dequeue-send-fail-free loop that wastes CPU cycles and generates
rapid skb allocation churn, leading to memory pressure from slab
fragmentation.

The RX path already has this guard (iwl_mld_rx_mpdu checks
in_hw_restart at rx.c:1906), and so does the TXQ allocation worker
(iwl_mld_add_txqs_wk at tx.c:156). Add the same guard to
iwl_mld_tx_from_txq() to stop all TX during firmware restart.

Frames left in mac80211's TXQs are naturally drained after restart
completes, when queue reallocation triggers iwl_mld_tx_from_txq()
via iwl_mld_add_txq_list(), or when new upper-layer traffic invokes
wake_tx_queue.

Tested on ASUS Zenbook 14 UX3405CA with Intel BE201 (Wi-Fi 7) on
kernel 6.19.5 where the firmware crashes approximately every 10-15
minutes under Tailscale traffic.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 在 Linux 内核 iwlwifi 驱动的 mld 子模块中，当固件崩溃（例如 Intel BE201 Wi-Fi 7 设备上的 NMI_INTERRUPT_UNKNOWN）进入重启流程时，驱动设置 mld->fw_status.in_hw_restart 为 true。但 TX 路径函数 iwl_mld_tx_from_txq() 未检查该标志，仍然从 mac80211 队列取出帧并推送到传输层。由于固件已死，iwl_trans_tx() 对每个帧返回 -EIO，导致帧立即释放。在高吞吐场景（如 Tailscale UDP 流量或活跃 SSH 会话）下，这会形成紧密的出队-发送失败-释放循环，浪费 CPU 并产生快速 skb 分配抖动，最终因 slab 碎片化引发内存压力。RX 路径（iwl_mld_rx_mpdu）和 TXQ 分配 worker（iwl_mld_add_txqs_wk）已有类似防护。该补丁在 iwl_mld_tx_from_txq() 中添加 in_hw_restart 检查，在固件重启期间停止所有 TX。重启完成后，队列重新分配或上层新流量触发 wake_tx_queue 时会自然排空留在 mac80211 TXQ 中的帧。影响 Intel BE201 (Wi-Fi 7) 等 iwlwifi 设备，在 Linux 6.19.5 上测试，固件约每 10-15 分钟崩溃一次。建议用户更新 Linux 内核至包含此补丁的版本（或相应发行版补丁）。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可导致受影响的 iwlwifi 设备在高吞吐场景下频繁固件崩溃时，驱动进入 CPU 密集型循环并引发内存压力，可能造成系统不稳定或拒绝服务。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 在固件重启期间，未停止 TX 导致错误帧处理循环，增加 CPU 负载并因 skb 分配碎片化消耗内存，可能引起系统性能下降或崩溃。

wifi: cfg80211: advance loop vars in cfg80211_merge_profile()

cfg80211_merge_profile() reassembles a Multi-...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

wifi: cfg80211: advance loop vars in cfg80211_merge_profile()

cfg80211_merge_profile() reassembles a Multi-BSSID non-transmitted BSS
profile that has been split across multiple consecutive MBSSID elements.
Its while-loop calls

	cfg80211_get_profile_continuation(ie, ielen, mbssid_elem, sub_elem)

but never advances mbssid_elem or sub_elem inside the body.  Each
iteration therefore searches for a continuation that follows the same
fixed pair; the helper returns the same next_mbssid; and the same
next_sub bytes are memcpy()'d into merged_ie at a growing offset until
the buffer fills.

Advance both mbssid_elem and sub_elem to the just-consumed continuation
so the next call to cfg80211_get_profile_continuation() searches for a
further continuation beyond it (or returns NULL when none exists).

A specially-crafted malicious beacon can take advantage of this bug
to cause the kernel to spend an excessive amount of time in
cfg80211_merge_profile (up to as much as 2ms per beacon received),
which could theoretically be abused in some way.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞存在于Linux内核的cfg80211无线配置子系统。函数cfg80211_merge_profile()用于重组在多BSSID元素中分段传输的非传输BSS配置文件。其while循环内部调用了cfg80211_get_profile_continuation()来查找下一个续接段，但循环体内未正确更新mbssid_elem和sub_elem指针，导致每次迭代都基于相同的起始位置重复查找，而非向后推进。这使得攻击者可以构造恶意的信标帧，强制内核在每次接收到该信标时反复执行无效的合并操作，直至缓冲区填满，消耗大量CPU时间（最多可达2毫秒/信标）。若攻击者持续发送此类信标，可造成CPU资源耗尽，引发拒绝服务（DoS）条件。该漏洞影响所有启用Multi-BSSID特性的内核版本，攻击者无需认证即可通过物理邻近的WiFi网络触发。修复方式为在内核中正确推进循环变量，确保每次迭代后索引指向已处理的数据。建议用户尽快更新至包含补丁的内核版本。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许非认证的远程攻击者通过发送特制WiFi信标帧消耗目标系统CPU资源，导致拒绝服务，影响WiFi功能及系统稳定性。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞允许非认证的远程攻击者通过发送特制WiFi信标帧消耗目标系统CPU资源，导致拒绝服务，影响WiFi功能及系统稳定性。

items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

tracing: Do not call map->ops->elt_free() if elt_alloc() fails

In paths where tracing_map_elt_alloc() failed to allocate objects,
the map->ops->elt_alloc() call was never successful. In this case,
map->ops->elt_free() should not be called.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞存在于 Linux 内核的 tracing 模块中。在 tracing_map_elt_alloc() 函数分配元素失败的情况下，错误处理路径会调用 map->ops->elt_free() 来释放之前分配的资源。然而，由于 elt_alloc() 并未成功，map->ops->elt_free() 可能会尝试释放未初始化的内存指针，导致内核内存管理错误。此漏洞可能引发内核崩溃、信息泄露或潜在的权限提升（如果结合其他利用手法）。该漏洞的 CVSS 评分未提供，但属于内核级别的缺陷，影响广泛。目前没有证据表明该漏洞已在野外被利用或列入已知被利用漏洞目录。建议 Linux 系统用户尽快应用官方补丁，以防止系统不稳定或安全风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞是 Linux 内核 tracing 子系统的内存管理缺陷，可能导致系统崩溃或信息泄露，影响内核稳定性和安全性。由于未提供 CVSS 评分且无在野利用证据，但作为内核漏洞值得关注，建议及时打补丁。

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

KVM: SVM: Disable AVIC IPI virtualization on Hygon Family 18h (erratum #1235)

Hygon Family 18h CPUs are der...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

KVM: SVM: Disable AVIC IPI virtualization on Hygon Family 18h (erratum #1235)

Hygon Family 18h CPUs are derived from AMD Family 17h (Zen1) silicon and
share the same erratum #1235: hardware may read a stale IsRunning=1 bit
during ICR write emulation and silently fail to generate an
AVIC_IPI_FAILURE_TARGET_NOT_RUNNING VM-Exit on the sending vCPU.

The absence of the VM-Exit causes KVM to miss the required wakeup of
blocking target vCPUs, leading to hung vCPUs and unbounded delays in
guest execution.

Extend the existing AMD Family 17h erratum #1235 workaround to also cover
Hygon Family 18h.  With IPI virtualization disabled, KVM never sets
IsRunning=1 in the Physical ID table, so every non-self IPI generates a
VM-Exit and is correctly emulated.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞影响 Linux 内核的 KVM 子系统，具体是 SVM （AMD 虚拟化） 中的 AVIC （Advanced Virtual Interrupt Controller） IPI （处理器间中断） 虚拟化功能。Hygon Family 18h CPU 源自 AMD Family 17h （Zen1） 架构，继承了相同的硬件勘误 #1235：当 KVM 使用 AVIC IPI 虚拟化时，硬件在 ICR 写入仿真过程中可能错误地读取到 IsRunning=1 的过期值，从而静默地不触发应有的 AVIC_IPI_FAILURE_TARGET_NOT_RUNNING VM-Exit。这导致发送中断的 vCPU 不会产生 VM-Exit，KVM 无法正确唤醒阻塞的目标 vCPU，进而造成目标 vCPU 永久挂起，导致客户机执行出现无界延迟。攻击者可以利用此漏洞发起拒绝服务攻击，通过精心编排的 IPI 序列使虚拟机内的 vCPU 无响应。修复方案：将现有的 AMD Family 17h 勘误 #1235 的缓解措施（即禁用 AVIC IPI 虚拟化）扩展至 Hygon Family 18h CPU。禁用后，KVM 不会在 Physical ID 表中设置 IsRunning=1，因此所有非自 IPI 都会生成 VM-Exit 并被正确仿真，从而避免挂起。受影响的系统包括所有使用 Hygon Family 18h CPU 并运行受影响内核版本的 Linux 主机。建议用户及时更新内核，应用包含此补丁的版本。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可导致虚拟机内 vCPU 挂起，造成拒绝服务，影响多租户环境稳定性。Hygon CPU 被国内云服务商广泛使用，修复需更新内核，暂无变通方案。

If tegra_i2c_mutex_lock() fails, the function returns...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

i2c: tegra: fix pm_runtime leak on mutex_lock failure

If tegra_i2c_mutex_lock() fails, the function returns without calling
pm_runtime_put(), leaking the runtime PM reference acquired by the
preceding pm_runtime_get_sync(). This prevents the device from ever
entering runtime suspend.

Add the missing pm_runtime_put() before returning on lock failure.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞存在于Linux内核的I2C Tegra驱动中（drivers/i2c/busses/i2c-tegra.c）。在函数tegra_i2c_xfer_msg()中，驱动先调用pm_runtime_get_sync()获取运行时PM引用计数，然后尝试获取互斥锁tegra_i2c_mutex_lock()。如果互斥锁获取失败（例如发生错误），函数会直接返回错误码，但并未调用pm_runtime_put()释放之前获取的PM引用。这导致PM引用计数泄漏，使得设备无法进入运行时挂起状态，从而影响电源管理效率。虽然该问题本身不直接导致内存破坏或权限提升，但长期运行可能导致设备无法低功耗，消耗额外电能，并在某些嵌入式场景中引发功能异常。修复方式是在锁失败的分支中添加pm_runtime_put()调用，确保资源平衡。该漏洞影响使用Tegra I2C控制器的Linux内核版本（具体版本范围待定）。建议受影响系统更新至包含该补丁的内核版本。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞导致运行时PM引用计数泄漏，设备无法进入低功耗状态，影响电源管理和系统稳定性。由于是驱动程序缺陷，可能影响所有使用Tegra I2C的嵌入式设备。
